content:
“In combat, there's no time to hesitate.”

**Quick Hands** is a perk in *Fallout 76*.

The Quick Hands perk gives the player an increasing chance for their weapon to instantly reload when it is emptied.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain a 18% chance to instantly reload when your clip is empty. | 003E862D | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain a 12% chance to instantly reload when your clip is empty. | 001D2478 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain a 6% chance to instantly reload when your clip is empty. | 000221FC | 

- This perk can trigger back-to-back after consecutive reloads.
- Update 65 enabled this perk on ghoul characters.

Quick Hands does not seem to work for single-shot weapons, such as black powder pistols and rifles, and the Dragon. Crossbows and bows are also affected; the latter may sometimes function with the perk, but due to the bow's mechanics, it's functionally irrelevant.

Other reload speed perks include:

- Ground Pounder - rifles
- Guerrilla Expert - scales with Onslaught stacks
- Lock and Load - reload speed bonus per stack
- Gun Tricks - reload speed bonus for ghoul characters
- Wild West Hands - chance to instantly reload magazine for ghoul characters
